purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software - hospital/clinic admission fee information settings screen (W28)
purpose.summary: This program implements the hospital admission fee information settings screen (ORCGW28) within the JMA ORCA medical receipt system. It handles screen initialization, data entry, and navigation for configuring ward-specific admission fee parameters including fee classification, unit price, and tax category. It interacts with system management master files and ward information via COPY-included file layouts.

notable_features: 46 COPY statements for modular screen/file layouts
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA parameters
EVALUATE MCP-STATUS ALSO MCP-EVENT dispatch pattern
BINARY usage for combo box counts
Japanese comments encoded in Latin-1 (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP garbled)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary MCP (Medical Care Platform) API
Screen area defined via multiple COPY includes (W01.INC through W99.INC)
verdict.notes: Source file contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, decoded as Latin-1 causing mojibake in comments. The MCP (Medical Care Platform) framework is the JMA ORCA GUI/DB middleware, not CICS; program_type set to online-cics as closest analog for an interactive screen program.
